The '''Nar Bo Sholla system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located in the region of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] known as [[Hutt Space/Legends|Hutt Space]]. The system contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Nar Bo Sholla]].
